task: Implement the academic-research-plugin DSH profile from its frozen planning docs (README/PRINCIPLES/ARCHITECTURE/EVIDENCE-ENGINE/ORCHESTRATION/TESTING) into a runnable, TUI/headless profile whose product is credibility: every claim carries a machine-decided verified/unverified state. Build sequentially by module M1-M8 with a deterministic gate + fresh adversarial attack + fix-audit at each stage, and the gated-vs-freehand + hyper-parallel-vs-serial A/B honest test as milestone 1 that green-lights the expensive scale-up.
loop_altitude_rationale: The PRODUCT is hyper-parallel multi-loop, but BUILDING it is strictly sequential: each module consumes the prior module's frozen contract on one shared build surface, so parallel construction would conflict-edit (P-11). Single-agent gated stages, no build-time fan-out — matches both house pipelines (plugin-creator/serper-harvester) which are medium with deliberate zero internal fan-out. Fan-out lives inside the built product's runtime, not inside its construction loop.

selection_log.why: every stage has a fast runnable done-check: headless `dsh --profile academic-research <task>` exit code, real-boot-with-fake-key gate, the 27 negative fixtures asserting rejection, gate-script exit codes on runs/_smoke, and the held-out eval harness exit code + scoreboard delta. Done is machine-decidable without a human reading output.

selection_log.answer: staged (8 seams by module dependency, ARCHITECTURE §4)
selection_log.why: each seam hands a stable checkable artifact downstream and its check runs without the downstream existing: booting profile -> green gates+fixtures -> booting plugin emitting evidence events -> a headless run producing a gate-passing claim ledger -> an A/B scoreboard delta -> a scaled+hardened system -> an attack+fix-audit ledger -> a wrapped+regressed profile. Contract-first (gates before the plugin that feeds them) satisfies seam-test (a): the gate scripts run standalone on _smoke fixtures.

skeleton and prose-exit-bench are mechanical (retry); the credibility core (evidence-contracts, academic-search, research-preset, hardening-scale) is risky and needs mid-flight correction (plan_execute_verify, red-green); milestone-1-ab is a quality judgment on the whole approach (review) with a human go/no-go; attack-fixaudit is adversarial (review).

dev-only, reversible, discriminating checks -> human reviews at gates. Exception: the A/B honest-test verdict (does hyper-parallel earn its cost, P-15) is a judgment no check can make — the check only proves the A/B RAN honestly with paired metrics; the human owns the go/no-go and a null result is an accepted honest outcome, not a failure to grind against (anti-reward-hacking, P-18).

stages are strictly sequential (each depends_on the prior); the single build surface makes parallel construction a shared-write conflict. The product's hyper-parallelism is a runtime property of M4, not a property of the build loop.

selection_log.answer: caps + loopback + pre-registered restart + budget/zero-change/min-progress gates
selection_log.why: per-stage caps; downstream failures loopback to the implicated upstream gate; evidence-contracts and academic-search carry pre-registered restart counters (a build-turned-archaeology is rewritten from the contract, not patched); outer zero-change brake + minimum-progress floor; house budget guard (DeepSeek balance floor + per-stage token cap).

selection_log.answer: completeness-first (mixed: red-green inner cycle is iteration-first)
selection_log.why: the discriminating checks are slow/expensive (headless dsh runs are minutes-long, real boots, held-out eval, e2e evidence-materialization) and the artifacts reward a coherent whole (contracts, a profile, a migration cutover), so few thorough passes beat many cheap ones -> low caps, plan_execute_verify, thorough checks. The exception is the negative-fixture red-green cycle inside evidence-contracts, which is genuinely iteration-first (fast unit checks) and carries a higher inner cap — recorded per-stage.

definition_of_done.goal: the profile ~/.dsh/profiles/academic-research (package.json dsh.profile.bundles + cordis.patch.yml) boots headless and exits 0 on a no-op task, and a real boot with a deliberately-fake API key dies at AUTH (not at the cordis plugin-loader), proving the bundle graph and every plugin's exported Config are valid

feedback_signal.check: dsh --profile academic-research --dump-config >/dev/null && DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-fake-000 dsh --profile academic-research 'noop; exit' 2>&1 | grep -q 'Authentication' && echo BOOT_OK
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: dump-config errors, OR the fake-key boot dies with a cordis-plugin-loader / Config-validation error instead of an AUTH error — proving a bundle or an exported Config schema is broken (the house plugin_load.sh lesson: dump-config alone passed a pure stub, only a real boot catches load-time invariants)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: a plugin that dump-config accepts but that has no `export const Config = z.object(...)` and would crash at load — ruled out: the fake-key real-boot must reach AUTH, which only happens after every plugin's load-time Config validation passes (@deepseek-ai/cordis runtime.Config.validate)

failure: 3 consecutive boots fail at plugin-loader with the same Config error (a bundle is structurally wrong, not our task)

definition_of_done.goal: the credibility core exists and is proven by red-green: claims.tsv 8-col schema + per-claim manifest + CAS; the M3 gate scripts (data 4-layer / source ladder / inference DAG / source-integrity L0-L1); all 27 EVIDENCE-ENGINE §6 negative fixtures are tool-triggered and assert-REJECTED; the fail-closed selftest includes the missing-panel negative case; status is written ONLY by the gate

feedback_signal.check: node checks/gates_selftest.mjs --fixtures 27 --require-all-red-then-green && python3 gates/run.py runs/_smoke && git diff gates-baseline-evidence -- checks/ gates/ | wc -l | grep -qx 0
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: any of the 27 negative fixtures is NOT rejected when tool-triggered (e.g. a constant/epsilon-dependency transform passes the input-dependency gate; a worker write to the status column is not rejected; a fabricated snapshot passes anti-forgery; reviewer_id==producer_id still writes a terminal state) — a fixture stays green when it must go red
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the fixtures 'pass' because they were weakened to vacuous asserts, or because a fixture file exists but is never tool-triggered ('存在即覆盖', banned by P-9) — ruled out: gates_selftest requires each fixture to first FAIL on the un-fixed gate (RED) then be rejected by the fixed gate (GREEN), and the baseline-tag diff proves no check/gate file drifted since the conductor committed it

failure: a fixture that was green goes red again after a fix to a sibling rule (patch-vs-break arms race)
the gate scripts cannot be made to reject all 27 fixtures without weakening an assertion

definition_of_done.goal: the M1 dsh-academic-search plugin retrieves via the academic stack + generic-web fallback chain, materializes each snapshot into CAS AT FETCH TIME with the tool executor recording the response sha256 in a log-only event, and the anti-forgery gate binds every manifest.snapshot_hash to a real tool RESULT event; pure lib/ has zero @deepseek-ai imports and unit-tests standalone

feedback_signal.check: npm --prefix dsh-academic-search test && bash checks/evidence_materialization_e2e.sh && node checks/antiforgery_probe.mjs --tamper-snapshot --expect-fail --bypass-gateway --expect-fail
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: the e2e run's session jsonl shows a manifest.snapshot_hash with no matching tool RESULT event hash; OR a tampered CAS snapshot still passes the anti-forgery gate; OR content fetched by a direct bash+curl (bypassing the gateway tool, thus no RESULT event) is accepted as evidence — any of these means provenance is not bound to runtime traces (P-10)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the plugin returns real search results but the snapshot bytes are the worker's self-reported extracted_text rather than the tool-executor's fetched bytes (the RT-4 bypass: real fetch + forged extract) — ruled out: antiforgery_probe tampers the extracted_text while leaving the CAS snapshot intact and asserts the gate matches against the门-side CAS extraction, not the worker's text

failure: a top-severity anti-forgery bypass lands inside the previous iteration's own fix (pre-registered stall -> restart, do not patch forward)
the fetch fallback chain cannot produce a bound snapshot for the golden source set after 5 iterations

definition_of_done.goal: M4 as a MINIMAL single external RESEARCH-ROUND (L1-L5 internal loops at fan-out 1) runs headless on a fixed golden topic and produces runs/<slug>/claims.tsv whose full gate run exits 0, with at least one claim of each kind (data/source/inference) reaching a terminal state (verified-*/contested/unverified) that was written only by the gate, never by the conductor

feedback_signal.check: dsh --profile academic-research "$(cat checks/golden-topic.txt)" && python3 gates/run.py runs/$(cat runs/LATEST) && node checks/assert_terminal_states.mjs --kinds data,source,inference --writer gate-only
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: the headless run exits non-zero, OR the produced ledger has no claim in some kind, OR assert_terminal_states finds a status transition whose session-event writer is the conductor/worker rather than the gate script — the credibility write-authority (RT-2) leaked
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the run produces a ledger where every claim is trivially 'unverified' (the loop did no real grounding) and the gate vacuously passes — ruled out: assert_terminal_states requires ≥1 claim per kind to reach a POSITIVE terminal state (verified-* or contested via a real reproduce/quote/inference gate), not merely the unverified default

failure: 3 consecutive runs produce a ledger with zero positively-verified claims (the loop is not doing real research, only defaulting to unverified)
goal-round-driver cannot drive a single round to a gate-passing ledger

definition_of_done.goal: MILESTONE 1 (P-15 honest test, gates the expensive scale-up): the held-out eval harness runs BOTH A/B arms to completion — arm A gated-vs-freehand, arm B hyper-parallel-vs-same-budget-serial — on physically isolated held-out tasks, and populates scoreboard.tsv with each success number paired to its integrity counterpart. The GATE is that the A/B ran honestly with paired metrics and burned-task isolation held; the VERDICT (proceed / redesign / honestly report null) is the human's

feedback_signal.check: node eval/harness.mjs --ab gated:freehand --ab parallel:serial-same-budget --held-out --fail-closed && node checks/scoreboard_integrity.mjs --require-paired-metrics --require-burned-task-isolation
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: the harness cannot complete either arm, OR the scoreboard has a success number with no paired integrity/damage metric (unpaired success = the shape of slop, P-18), OR a held-out task that entered any dev loop is re-scored (isolation broken), OR the two arms differ in a variable other than the one under test (gated-ness / parallelism)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the A/B is tuned until gated+parallel wins (reward-hacking the honest test) — ruled out: the gate does NOT check 'gated wins'; it checks the run completed with paired metrics and isolation intact. A null or negative result (parallel does not beat serial) PASSES this gate and ESCALATES to the human go/no-go, which may honestly stop the project ('do not add more framework to hide it')

failure: the held-out eval harness or the isolation checker cannot be made to run to completion (infra broken, not a result)

definition_of_done.goal: ONLY after the human green-lights milestone 1: M5 eval-track fail-closed (eval-of-eval negative tests) + M4 scaled to hyper-parallel multi-loop, proven safe by concurrent-write integrity and the flat hyper-parallel regression curve

feedback_signal.check: node eval/selftest.mjs --plant confident-but-wrong --expect REVISE --plant missing-panel --expect NOT-SHIP && node checks/concurrent_admission.mjs --grounders 8 --assert-no-corruption && node checks/parallel_regression.mjs --toolcalls 2,20,150 --assert-support-rate-flat
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: a planted confident-but-wrong candidate is NOT forced to REVISE, OR a missing-panel candidate can SHIP (fail-closed broken, TESTING §8), OR 8 concurrent grounders corrupt the ledger (admission serialization broken, RT-18), OR citation-support-rate falls as tool-calls scale 2->150 (parallelism amplifies sourcing error, TESTING §3)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the parallel regression 'passes' because it never actually reached 150 concurrent tool-calls (fan-out capped silently) — ruled out: parallel_regression asserts the achieved tool-call count reached each target before it judges the support-rate curve

failure: 2 consecutive iterations fail in the same class (eval-of-eval or concurrent-write)
the flat-curve property cannot be met without capping fan-out below the design's parallelism target

definition_of_done.goal: M6 house attack battery over the BUILT system (not the docs): seed-verified multi-lens attackers + a cross-vendor attacker find defects; every P1/P2 is adjudicated and fixed; a fresh-context fix-audit (never saw the fixes) confirms the repairs are real and introduced no new contradiction

feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: a lens run misses its planted seed (attacker is blind, run void — not counted), OR any P1/P2 is left open, OR the fresh-context fix-audit returns FIX_FIRST (a repair was cosmetic or introduced a new defect)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the battery reports clean because the attackers were weak (found nothing), read as 'system clean' — ruled out: the seed gate voids any lens run that misses its fingerprinted seed, so 'clean' only counts when the attackers demonstrably CAN find planted defects

failure: a P1 lands inside the previous round's own fix (fix-audit rotation stall -> loop back to the implicated module stage, do not patch forward)
3 attack rounds fail to reach CONVERGED

definition_of_done.goal: M7 thin prose exit (every empirical sentence cites a claim_id, zero ledger-external assertions) + M8 headless regression batch green with an append-only scoreboard, closing the build

feedback_signal.check: node checks/prose_exit_closure.mjs --assert-sentences-subset-of-ledger && bash checks/regression_batch.sh --headless --assert-exit-codes && node checks/scoreboard_append_only.mjs
feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: the prose exit emits an empirical sentence with no claim_id or an assertion absent from the ledger (ledger-external claim leaked into prose), OR a regression-batch headless run exits non-zero, OR a scoreboard row was deleted/mutated (append-only violated)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: the closure check passes because the prose is empty / trivially cites but the citations point at unverified claims presented as settled — ruled out: prose_exit_closure asserts every load-bearing empirical sentence maps to a claim_id AND surfaces that claim's actual state (verified/contested/unverified), never laundering an unverified claim into declarative prose

failure: the regression batch cannot be made green without weakening a check

human_placement_note: on_the_loop at every stage gate; ONE in_the_loop exception — the milestone-1-ab go/no-go verdict (the P-15 honest-test decision: proceed to scale / redesign / honestly report a null result and stop) is a judgment no check can make and must not be reward-hacked. Captured as the milestone-1-ab stage's review pattern + escalate-on-null routing, and in D3 of the selection_log.

maker_checker.scope: at each stage a fresh adversarial evaluator context (never saw the generator's impl or reasoning) is told the artifact is broken and must prove it — this IS the per-stage attack verification. For the credibility-core stages it runs the house lens battery (coherence/gaming/evidence/reality/foundation) + a cross-vendor attacker; it verifies the gate DISCRIMINATES (would fail on a broken impl), not merely that a green check exists. The conductor owns checks/ and .loop-state/ (generator may not edit them) and commits gates-baseline-<stage> tags so a gate is honoured only when git diff against its baseline tag is empty and the tree is clean.

planner.mandate: Fable conductor: read the frozen planning docs -> per-stage spec + the negotiated contract assertions; never writes plugin/gate/preset code. Resolves the docs as the frozen contract source (README/PRINCIPLES/ARCHITECTURE/EVIDENCE-ENGINE/ORCHESTRATION/TESTING), not its own memory.

generator.mandate: Opus subagents: write the plugin/gates/preset/checks to satisfy the contract; may NOT weaken a check, edit checks/ or .loop-state/, or grade their own output. Negative tests must be red-before-green with the RED evidence committed.

evaluator.mandate: a FRESH context that never saw the impl or the generator's reasoning; assume the credibility machinery is broken and prove it — forge a snapshot, bypass the gateway, launder an unverified claim into verified via a constant transform or a self-reviewed rescue, game the head metric denominator, break burned-task isolation. Different-vendor attacker on the high-stakes stages buys model-tier independence. A fixer never audits its own fix (fix-audit rotation).

assertions.must: the profile boots headless and exits 0 on a no-op task
a real boot with a fake API key dies at AUTH, not at the cordis plugin-loader, and every plugin exports a valid Config
all 27 EVIDENCE-ENGINE §6 negative fixtures are tool-triggered and each is RED-before-green then rejected by the fixed gate

the claims.tsv status column is physically written ONLY by the gate script; admission writes new rows at status=pending; a worker/conductor write attempt to status is observably rejected and the column is unchanged
a constant transform and an epsilon-dependency transform both FAIL the data input-dependency gate, while a genuinely input-dependent transform PASSES (the trichotomy)

reviewer!=producer is enforced from the harness childId in session events, not a self-reported manifest field; a verdict whose reviewer childId equals the producer childId cannot write a terminal state
load-bearing is machine-decided: a claim that is prose-cited OR an inference premise OR on a conclusion chain is immutably load-bearing; an author 'non-load-bearing' mark on such a claim is rejected
an inference whose conclusion is stronger than its steps support is caught by the reviewer's conclusion-strength question
the fail-closed selftest includes a missing-panel negative case proving a missing eval dimension cannot yield SHIP
every manifest.snapshot_hash binds to a real tool RESULT event hash in the session jsonl; a tampered CAS snapshot fails anti-forgery
a fabricated URL not present in any tool RESULT event fails the anti-forgery gate
evidence fetched by bypassing the gateway tool (direct bash+curl, no RESULT event) is rejected as unbindable
a load-bearing source claim requires >=2 independent-publisher sources; a two-preprint combo gets a preprint-only flag and verified-by-source is downgraded
the retraction / hijacked-journal L0 join runs offline and default-on; citing retracted work raises a flag
the pure lib/ has zero @deepseek-ai imports and its unit tests pass standalone
a headless run produces a claim ledger with >=1 claim per kind (data/source/inference) reaching a POSITIVE terminal state written only by the gate
the milestone-1 A/B runs BOTH arms (gated:freehand and parallel:serial-same-budget) to completion on held-out tasks and populates the scoreboard
every scoreboard success number is paired with an integrity/damage metric (unpaired success is rejected) and a held-out task that entered any dev loop is never re-scored
the head metric denominator is the ledger load-bearing set UNION the prose (measured held-out side), never the L1 pass-rate; a prose that narrates only verified claims cannot inflate it
eval-of-eval: a planted confident-but-wrong candidate is forced to REVISE and a missing-panel candidate cannot SHIP
assertions.check: node eval/selftest.mjs --plant confident-but-wrong --expect REVISE --plant missing-panel --expect NOT-SHIP

assertions.must: 8 concurrent grounders do not corrupt the ledger (admission single-instance lock + content-hash keys)
citation-support-rate stays flat as tool-calls scale 2->20->150 (parallelism does not amplify sourcing error), and the achieved tool-call count reached each target
the attack battery is seed-verified (planted seeds hit, blind runs voided) and a fresh-context fix-audit returns CONVERGED with zero open P1/P2
the prose exit emits only ledger-backed empirical sentences (each cites a claim_id and surfaces its true state), zero ledger-external assertions
no gate/test/check assertion is weakened relative to its gates-baseline tag over the whole build
assertions.check: human-verify: the evaluator diffs checks/ and gates/ against each gates-baseline-<stage> tag and confirms no assertion was loosened (includes untracked files via git status --porcelain)

assertions.must: every gate threshold is calibrated on a self-built golden set, never a number copied from the survey/literature (P-21)
assertions.check: human-verify: the evaluator confirms each numeric threshold traces to a runs/_calib golden artifact, not a SURVEY citation

assertions.must: all runtime/debug/verification surfaces are TUI/headless (dsh --profile, exit codes); no gate or acceptance step depends on the WebUI

harness_primitives: the frozen planning docs (README/PRINCIPLES/ARCHITECTURE/EVIDENCE-ENGINE/ORCHESTRATION/TESTING) as the immutable contract source the planner reads each stage

checks/ and .loop-state/ owned exclusively by the conductor; generator may not edit them; a gate counts only when git status --porcelain -- checks/ .loop-state/ is clean AND git diff gates-baseline-<stage> -- checks/ is empty (catches committed tampering + untracked shadow files)
.loop-state/STATE.md (per-stage status + spend), findings.json (attack ledger: lenses[] + findings[] with severity/evidence/fix_commit), DECISIONS.md — durable across compaction/context resets
runs/_smoke as the resident golden self-test run; runs/_calib as the threshold-calibration golden set
e2e-session.jsonl + metrics.json recomputed FROM the jsonl every gate (never trust self-reported numbers — house R5 lesson: the driver model has forged plausible citations)
git worktree isolation per stage + gates-baseline-<stage> tags committed by the conductor before the generator receives a stage
held-out eval task set + rubric stored in a separate directory that never enters any agent context (physical isolation, burned-task ledger)

stop_conditions.success: all eight stages' checks pass in dependency order (skeleton -> evidence-contracts -> academic-search -> research-preset-min -> milestone-1-ab -> hardening-scale -> attack-fixaudit -> prose-exit-bench), the milestone-1 human go/no-go was recorded, and the built profile runs a research task headless producing a gate-passing claim ledger whose prose exit is ledger-closed. Minimum-progress floor: every stage gate must have been reached and attempted with a real diff, and milestone-1-ab must have produced a populated paired-metric scoreboard, before any stop is honoured — a stop below that floor escalates, it does not count as done.
failure: any stage exhausts its max_iterations without passing its check
a downstream stage forces a redesign of an already-accepted upstream stage twice (error amplification -> escalate the contract, not the build)
2 consecutive outer iterations produce zero new file changes (zero-change gate: the loop is buying iterations, stop)

2 consecutive iterations fail in the same class OR a top-severity defect lands inside the previous iteration's own fix (pre-registered stall -> the stage's on_failure restart fires; do not patch forward)
DeepSeek balance floor breached (< the pre-set threshold) — shared budget guard, stop rather than overrun (house precedent)
escalate: milestone-1-ab produces a null or negative A/B result (hyper-parallel does not beat same-budget serial, or gated does not beat freehand) — escalate the P-15 go/no-go to the human; honestly report and possibly stop, do NOT tune the A/B until it wins
a change to the frozen planning-doc contract becomes necessary (the contract is wrong, not the build)
real credentials, real user data, or a non-headless surface becomes required to verify a gate
the loop proposes to stop before the minimum-progress floor (premature-abandonment gate)

risk_guards.risk: reward hacking the gates — the system being BUILT is itself a gate-checker, so the generator has an unusually direct incentive to weaken the very credibility gates it implements (the deepest overfitting surface in this build)
risk_guards.mitigation: A25 diffs every check against its gates-baseline tag; the fresh adversarial evaluator re-derives whether each gate DISCRIMINATES (red-before-green fixtures); conductor owns checks/ and the generator cannot edit them; attack-fixaudit stage re-attacks the built gates cross-vendor

risk_guards.risk: reward hacking the A/B honest test — tuning the loop until gated+parallel wins, defeating the whole P-15 point
risk_guards.mitigation: milestone-1-ab's gate checks the A/B RAN with paired metrics + isolation, NOT that gated wins; a null result passes the gate and escalates to a human verdict; the held-out set is physically isolated with a burned-task ledger so it cannot be tuned against

risk_guards.risk: error amplification — a wrong evidence-contract (stage 2) silently poisons every downstream credibility judgment
risk_guards.mitigation: contract-first with 27 red-before-green fixtures gates stage 2 before anything consumes it; downstream failures loopback to evidence-contracts rather than patching in place; stage 2 carries a restart (not loopback) because a rotted contract is rewritten, not patched

risk_guards.risk: context drift / provenance rot over a long multi-stage build — the credibility claims of the build itself decay
risk_guards.mitigation: durable .loop-state on disk survives compaction; metrics always recomputed from e2e-session.jsonl; the planner re-reads the frozen docs each stage rather than its own memory; A26 forbids literature-cited thresholds

risk_guards.risk: token / budget blowup — the product's hyper-parallelism multiplied across build iterations
risk_guards.mitigation: per-stage token caps + the DeepSeek balance floor stop condition (house shared-balance guard); build-time loop is medium (no fan-out) so construction cost is bounded even though the product fans out at runtime

risk_guards.risk: premature over-delegation — spinning up the hyper-parallel M4 machinery before the minimal loop is proven
risk_guards.mitigation: milestone-1-ab (a MINIMAL single-loop A/B) gates the hardening-scale stage; the expensive multi-loop scale-up only proceeds on a human green-light, faithful to P-15 'prove it before building more framework'
